description:
Performs a focused HTML DOM accessibility evaluation on a target URL against WCAG 2.1 AA, WCAG 2.1 AAA, or U.S. Section 508 standards. Inspects missing image 'alt' attributes (SC 1.1.1), HTML5 semantic/ARIA landmarks (SC 1.3.1), programmatic form input labels (SC 3.3.2), document '<title>' presence (SC 2.4.2), and '<html lang>' declaration (SC 3.1.1), applying standard-specific grading thresholds.

When to use vs. related tools: Call 'audit_accessibility' when you need granular accessibility counts, standard-specific grading (including WCAG_2.1_AAA or Section_508), and remediation items without privacy/cookie auditing. Call 'audit_site' for combined privacy + security + accessibility scoring.

Preconditions & side effects: Requires a reachable public HTTP(S) URL; no registry siteId or authentication required. Read-only live HTTP inspection with zero state mutation.

Returns: JSON object containing 'success', 'audit_id', 'target_url', 'standard', 'accessibility_score' (0-100), 'wcag_compliance_grade' ('AAA' | 'AA' | 'A' | 'CONFORMANT' | 'NON_COMPLIANT'), itemized 'metrics', 'violations', 'remediation_actions', 'timestamp', and optional 'error'.

standard.description: Accessibility conformance standard and grading threshold to evaluate against.

url.description: Full public HTTP or HTTPS URL of the webpage to audit for accessibility.

name: audit_accessibility

error.description: Failure reason when target is unreachable or input is invalid.

metrics.description: Granular DOM accessibility counts and flags.

has_document_title.description: Whether a non-empty <title> element is present.

has_html_lang.description: Whether the <html> tag specifies a valid lang attribute.

images_compliant.description: Count of tags with valid alt attributes.

images_missing_alt.description: Count of tags lacking alt text.

landmarks_detected.description: Semantic HTML5/ARIA landmarks present on the page.

missing_form_labels.description: Count of form controls missing programmatic labels.

remediation_actions.description: Prioritized remediation steps mapped to detected violations.

items.description: Recommended engineering fix for a violation.

success.description: True if target URL was reachable and parsed; false otherwise.

items.description: Specific WCAG or Section 508 violation description.

title: WCAG 2.1 & Section 508 Accessibility Audit
